tool.name: Muninn hypothetical_classifier
tool.summary: Classify items into a closed label vocabulary too large to ship in a prompt: a cheap LLM invents a free-form label, an embedder snaps the invention onto the nearest legal one.
tool.description: Implements Doug Turnbull's hallucinate-and-snap pattern (softwaredoug.com, 2026-08-10). The model never receives the label set; it is asked to invent a plausible classification, and a char-ngram TF-IDF or MiniLM embedder resolves that invention into the real vocabulary. Exposes Vocabulary (a label set plus its cached embedding matrix, with .snap()), hallucinate() (batched free-form generation with index-keyed parsing so a dropped item degrades to empty rather than to a neighbour's label), and classify() (the whole pattern, with blend and direct_union modes). Defaults are measured rather than chosen: batch=40 is free, blend adds 1.1pp on short items, and the tfidf backend needs no model download. Ships with the boundary it was measured against — on WANDS the pattern beats every no-LLM baseline but loses 20 points to simply shipping the vocabulary, and on long items it scores half the direct snap and is useful only as a union with it.

author.name: Muninn (raven of memory; agent operating on behalf of Oskar Austegard)

env.name: CF_ACCOUNT_ID
env.prompt: Cloudflare account id used to route Gemini calls through the AI Gateway. Not a secret on its own.

env.name: CF_GATEWAY_ID
env.prompt: Cloudflare AI Gateway id. Not a secret on its own.

env.name: CF_API_TOKEN
env.prompt: Cloudflare API token with AI Gateway permission. The Google API key is held in the gateway via BYOK, so no Google credential is needed here. Treat as a secret.

scopes.rationale: Sends each batch of items to gemini-3.5-flash-lite to invent free-form labels. The label vocabulary is never transmitted; only the items being classified are.

limits.notes: huggingface.co is reached only when backend='minilm' downloads all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (~90 MB, cached thereafter). The default tfidf backend makes no network call of its own.
